prompt_md: How many rectangles of any size, squares included, can you find on an 8 by 8 chessboard, with sides along the grid lines?
prompt_short: Rectangles of every size on a chessboard, squares included?
hint_md: A rectangle is fixed by choosing 2 of the 9 vertical lines and 2 of the 9 horizontal lines.
explain_intuition_md: 204 is the famous count of squares, and it's only a small part of the answer. Any rectangle is pinned down by picking two of the 9 vertical grid lines and two of the 9 horizontal ones. That's 36 choices times 36 choices.
